CirQX 
One App. Smarter Retail. Greener Future. 
Version 1.0 Founder Business Blueprint

1. Executive Summary 
CirQX is an AI-powered retail intelligence and circular commerce platform designed for 
India’s local retail ecosystem. 
The platform helps retailers: 
• Manage inventory 
• Forecast demand 
• Reduce stockouts 
• Increase sales 
• Retain customers 
• Participate in sustainability programs 
• Generate additional revenue through recycling 
Unlike traditional inventory software, CirQX creates a connected ecosystem between: 
• Retailers 
• Customers 
• Recyclers 
• Pickup

• Retailers 
• Customers 
• Recyclers 
• Pickup Partners 
• Brands 
The long-term vision is to become the operating system for local commerce and 
sustainability in India.

2. Problem Statement 
Retailers 
Retailers struggle with: 
• Inventory management 
• Stockouts 
• Overstocking 
• Manual record keeping 
• Low customer retention 
• Competition from quick commerce

Customers 
Customers struggle with: 
• Waiting at stores 
• No easy ordering system 
• No rewards for sustainable behavior 
• No convenient recycling process

Recyclers 
Recyclers struggle with: 
• Fragmented waste collection 
• Lack of supply visibility 
• High collection costs

Job Seekers 
Many individuals seek: 
• Flexible side income 
• Local gig opportunities 
• Part-time earning options

1. Input Sources (Data Coming In)

This is where CirQX gets its information. 
Sales Channels 
Data comes from: 
• POS/Billing systems 
• E-commerce websites 
• Marketplaces 
Example: 
Yesterday Store A sold: 
• 50 Coke bottles 
• 20 Milk packets 
• 10 Biscuit packs 
CirQX receives this automatically.

Inventory & Supply 
Data comes from: 
• Current stock levels 
• Purchase orders 
• Supplier information 
Example: 
Store has: 
• 100 Coke bottles left 
• Supplier delivery takes 3 days

Marketing & Promotions

• Discounts

Example: 
Store is running: 
"Buy 1 Get 1 Free" on chips.

External Data

• Diwali coming next week

3 years of sales history.

One-Line Summary 
CirQX takes sales, inventory, weather, promotions, and business data as input, uses AI to 
predict future demand, and outputs inventory, purchasing, and business recommendations 
that help retailers make more money while reducing waste.

Imagine a kirana store owner, supermarket chain, distributor, or FMCG company using CirQX. 
Every day, their business generates huge amounts of information: products are sold at the 
billing counter, inventory levels change, suppliers deliver goods, promotions are launched, and 
external events such as weather, holidays, and festivals influence customer buying behavior . 
Most businesses either ignore this data or store it across multiple disconnected systems. CirQX 
acts as the central

disconnected systems. CirQX 
acts as the central intelligence layer that continuously collects all of this information into one 
platform. Data can enter through POS systems, ERP systems, e-commerce platforms, inventory 
software, APIs, Excel files, Google Sheets, or even manual entry. Instead of requiring businesses 
to replace their existing tools, CirQX connects to them and becomes the brain sitting above 
them. 
Once the data enters CirQX, it passes through a processing layer where the

it passes through a processing layer where the platform 
automatically cleans, validates, and standardizes the information. In the real world, data is 
messy. One store may call a product "Coke," another may call it "Coca-Cola 500ml," and another 
may use a SKU code. CirQX recognizes these inconsistencies and converts everything into a 
unified format. Missing values, duplicate records, incorrect entries, and data quality issues are 
identified and corrected. The system then enriches the

and corrected. The system then enriches the business data with external intelligence 
such as weather forecasts, local events, public holidays, school schedules, seasonal trends, 
economic indicators, and market conditions. The result is a continuously growing historical data 
warehouse that represents a complete picture of the business and its environment. 
The forecasting engine is the core of CirQX. Using historical sales patterns, inventory movement, 
promotional activity, seasonality, and

movement, 
promotional activity, seasonality, and external factors, machine learning models continuously 
learn how demand behaves for every product, category, store, and region. Rather than simply 
predicting future sales, the platform tries to understand the drivers behind demand. For 
example, it may discover that cold drink sales increase during heat waves, snacks sell more 
during cricket tournaments, or specific products spike before festivals. The models are retrained 
regularly as new

The models are retrained 
regularly as new data arrives, allowing forecasts to improve over time. The system can generate 
short-term forecasts for the next few days as well as long-term forecasts for weeks or months 
ahead. 
Beyond forecasting, CirQX functions as a decision intelligence platform. Once future demand is 
predicted, the platform calculates the actions a business should take. It determines optimal 
inventory levels, recommends purchase quantities, identifies products that are

purchase quantities, identifies products that are likely to run out 
of stock, and highlights slow-moving inventory that ties up cash unnecessarily. Instead of merely 
presenting numbers, CirQX translates predictions into business recommendations. A store 
owner does not see "Forecast = 350 units." They see "Order 120 additional units within the next 
three days to avoid stockouts during the upcoming festival period." This is where the platform 
moves from analytics to decision-making.

Another important capability is scenario planning. Businesses constantly face uncertainty. 
Suppliers may delay shipments, prices may change, promotions may perform differently than 
expected, or unexpected events may affect demand. CirQX allows users to simulate different 
scenarios before making decisions. A retailer can ask questions such as: "What happens if 
demand increases by 30% next week?" or "What if my supplier delivery is delayed by five days?"

if my supplier delivery is delayed by five days?" 
The system recalculates forecasts and inventory requirements, helping businesses proactively 
prepare rather than react after problems occur . 
As businesses continue using CirQX, the platform develops a deep understanding of their 
operations. Dashboards provide visibility into sales trends, inventory health, forecast accuracy, 
stockout risks, purchasing efficiency, supplier performance, and revenue opportunities. 
Managers can monitor their

opportunities. 
Managers can monitor their entire business from a single interface. Reports can be exported or 
integrated into ERP , accounting, and business intelligence systems. Executives receive strategic 
insights, while store managers receive operational recommendations tailored to their daily 
responsibilities. 
In the future, CirQX could evolve beyond forecasting into a network intelligence platform. If 
multiple retailers choose to participate, anonymized and aggregated market signals

anonymized and aggregated market signals could reveal 
broader demand trends across cities, regions, and categories. A retailer would not only know 
what happened in their own store but also gain visibility into emerging trends in the wider 
market. This creates a powerful data network effect where every participant benefits from the 
collective intelligence of the ecosystem while maintaining privacy.

forecasts, convert forecasts into actionable recommendations, and help businesses make 
smarter decisions. Instead of relying on intuition, spreadsheets, or reactive management, 
companies use CirQX to anticipate demand, optimize inventory, improve cash flow, reduce
